// Command probe reads each case named on the command line, `<kind>:<path>`, with the generated
// Go readers and prints one `<reader> <verdict>` line each (TestRangeRoundTrip, CODEGEN.md §5.15):
// a probe case with lib's types-mode DecodeProbe and with app's data loader on the file's .data
// twin; an items or tags file with app's data loader.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"example.com/gen/app"
	"example.com/gen/lib"
)

func main() {
	for _, arg := range os.Args[1:] {
		kind, path, _ := strings.Cut(arg, ":")
		switch kind {
		case "probe":
			raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			_, err = lib.DecodeProbe(raw)
			report("go-types", err)
			_, err = app.LoadProbe(path + ".data")
			report("go-data", err)
		case "caps":
			raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			_, err = lib.DecodeCapsFile(raw)
			report("go-file", err)
		case "items":
			_, err := app.LoadItems(path)
			report("go-data", err)
		case "tags":
			_, err := app.LoadTags(path)
			report("go-data", err)
		}
	}
}

func report(reader string, err error) {
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println(reader + " ok")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(reader + " error " + strings.ReplaceAll(err.Error(), "\n", `\n`))
}
